contract_grounding.relevant_contract_text: Creating a collection with the same name twice must fail on the second attempt (assertion: create(collection) -> create(collection) must return 400 with 'collection already exists')

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST v2 handler_v2.go:2060 -> proxy.CreateCollection -> root_coord.CreateCollection:902 -> broadcastCreateCollectionV1 -> validateIfCollectionExists:531 -> Equal check:534 -> return errIgnoredCreateCollection:537 -> caught at root_coord.go:903 -> return merr.Success():906
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: collection creation 实现了重复检查逻辑(validateIfCollectionExists),但当发现同名且相同schema的collection时,系统设计为'幂等创建'(返回 errIgnoredCreateCollection),然后在CreateCollection中捕获此错误并返回 SUCCESS(而非400错误)。这与契约约束(milvus_invariant_create_duplicate_001)明确要求的'must return 400 with collection already exists'矛盾。

verdicts.rationale: 原 oracle 断言正确 - 第2次 POST /collections/create (同名同参数) 返回 HTTP 200 {"code":0} 违反了契约约束 milvus_invariant_create_duplicate_001 ('Creating a collection with the same name twice must fail on the second attempt')。源码接地证实: Milvus 实现了'幂等创建'逻辑(create_collection_task.go:537 返回 errIgnoredCreateCollection → root_coord.go:906 捕获后返回 SUCCESS),但这是未文档化的内部行为,与公开契约矛盾。反向证伪显示只有1个collection实例存在(非真重复),证明这是设计上的幂等行为而非真正的重复创建失败。该行为违反 API 契约明确要求,应返回400错误而非200成功。
